status: BLOCKED — depends on step 1 (molecule) and step 7 (inverse reconstruction model)
purpose: Specify the relationship between ICP and molecule release rate from the transducer.

specification.release_law_form: R(P) = R0 + alpha * (P - P0), where R0 = baseline release at P0=10 mmHg, alpha = pressure sensitivity
specification.R0_target_nm_per_min: 1-100 (so that sensor can detect baseline AND changes)
specification.response_time_sec: <= 60 (so that clinically meaningful ICP changes are tracked in real time)
specification.hysteresis_percent: < 5 (no significant difference between rising and falling pressure)

what_unfreezes_this: Step 1 (molecule) + mechanical design of transducer (membrane deformation -> release rate).

transducer_mechanism_options.name: Deformable porous membrane (mechanical)
transducer_mechanism_options.principle: ICP deforms membrane, changes pore size, modulates release rate.
transducer_mechanism_options.commercial_reference: Existing drug-eluting implants use similar principles
transducer_mechanism_options.status: ENGINEERABLE — but specific molecule release rate must be measured for any chosen membrane

transducer_mechanism_options.name: Phase-change transducer
transducer_mechanism_options.principle: ICP shifts phase transition temperature, modulates release.

transducer_mechanism_options.name: Mechanophore transducer
transducer_mechanism_options.principle: ICP directly triggers mechanophore cleavage, releasing molecule.
